create_MSELoss: create a MSELoss criterion to measure mean squared error between encrypted prediction and target tensors
create_L1Loss: create a L1Loss criterion to measure mean absolute error between encrypted prediction and target tensors
create_BCELoss: create a BCELoss criterion to measure binary cross entropy between encrypted prediction and target tensors
create_CrossEntropyLoss: create a CrossEntropyLoss criterion to measure cross entropy loss for classification with encrypted tensors
create_RAPPORLoss: create a RAPPORLoss criterion to compute BCEWithLogitsLoss with randomized response corrections using alpha parameter
